Promotion ROI Analysis

Did real grocery promotions actually make money? Each effect is isolated with two independent counterfactuals (interrupted time series and synthetic control), then netted of cannibalization and discount cost. 300 promotions, Corporación Favorita data.

Overall verdict

How credible is the net-negative verdict?

Break-even — how much the verdict leans on the assumptions

Key question 3 — naive wins that lose money

A "naive win" is any promotion whose promotion-window sales rose versus the counterfactual. The flip count is how many of those are net negative once cannibalization (pulled-forward demand) and the discount cost are subtracted.

Sensitivity to the modeled assumptions

Discount depth × gross margin. Each cell shows median net profit (margin-units) and the % net negative. The verdict direction is robust across the grid.
